result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **Linear** as the best overall project management tool, particularly if you're building a tech, SaaS, or product-led business.

However, the best choice depends on your startup's size, team structure, and how you work. You don't want to introduce an overly complicated tool when you're trying to move quickly.

## My top 5 project management tools for startups

![Creating the Ideal Team Workflow with Linear and Github | by Catherine Angel | Medium](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tIC1JhwDu7kk1a9yhOLZIj2tCLRSAgY1Y-Ufm8GgAUU9wgrKUK6e7hYfMyjorAYNO78K-cjzFbL6vIoFuq9Mx5rV98n7fy_vRYV0jxoQPT-23iEF07RsofGisMA2pRN7YEdMz9L3gEBGuGw8K8-AENJT1_6Yzo6g0_H2dB0NFg2MvsKEHwJqtdYbsrqnOZhY?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning
- Great GitHub integration
- Fast, clean interface
- Less suited to general business operations

Free plan available; paid plans available.

[Visit Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one solution)

- Tasks, projects, documents and goals
- Dashboards and automation
- Highly customizable
- Can become cluttered if overconfigured

Free plan available; paid plans from around US\$7/user/month.

[Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

- Project management plus company wiki
- Meeting notes, SOPs and documentation
- Flexible databases and task tracking
- Less structured for complex execution

Free plan available; paid plans available.

[Visit Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![Introducing Status for remote work • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JoierB-tO_00cduG2D81oKuCvdoyZCElp3bd35lcWALcBpW38axGIp0CC5GaQbqWOOkxY6bkkYIgINigcMs7b9WeuaVIp_po7Lw148-t-fKTF_zSNsVOvmWGGRaLv9NtvMW858uJe_Q2tTfzckYfVF8jui4Tyz-v30ONFO8slcrt9_8tb3TIFzeV-apOQxtA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Great for cross-functional teams
- Clear ownership and accountability
- Project timelines and dependencies
- More structured than some early-stage teams need

Free plan available; paid plans available.

[Visit Asana](https://asana.com/)

## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 founders | Notion or Trello |
| 5–15 employees | ClickUp |
| Software/SaaS startup | Linear |
| 15–50 employees | Asana or Monday |
| Very tight budget | ClickUp |


## What I'd actually implement

For an early-stage startup, I'd avoid buying too many tools.

A practical setup would be\:

- **ClickUp\:** All projects, tasks, deadlines and accountability.
- **Notion\:** Company knowledge, meeting notes, strategy and SOPs.
- **Slack\:** Team communication.

If you're a software startup, I'd swap ClickUp for Linear for product and engineering work.

## Let me narrow it down to the best choice

There are three things that would change my recommendation\:

**1\. What type of startup are you building?**

SaaS / technology

AI startup

E-commerce

Agency / services

Other / mixed business

---

**2\. How big is your team?**

1–2 founders

2–10 people

10–25 people

25–50 people

50+ people

---

**3\. What matters most?**

One central system for everything

Tracking projects, tasks and deadlines

Product development and engineering

Team accountability and execution

Strategic planning, OKRs and company goals

---

**4\. What's your budget?**

Prefer free or inexpensive

US\$50–150/month

US\$150–500/month

Flexible if it delivers value

I'll use those answers to recommend one platform, rather than give you another long list of software to choose from.
